title: Repair a defect that spans two crates
goal: Refunds are handled wrongly in two places: imported refunds written in accounting style as (4.00) are counted as positive amounts, and statements print negative amounts garbled. Fix both, across whichever crates need it, without changing existing tests. Run the tests.

context.targeted: Accounting negatives are read by ledger-import; amounts are printed by ledger-core's Display.

acceptance.description: Negative amounts display correctly and round-trip; padding aligns; parentheses are negative; refunds balance and reduce the expense.

expected_failure_modes: fixing one of the two crates
negating in the report instead of the importer
